path.description: The source file or directory path to check

check_regex.description: Regular expression of files to include when more than one PATH is provided

ignore_regex.description: Regular expression of files to skip when more than one PATH is provided

lines.description: Number of lines to parse from top of each file; set to 0 to parse the whole file

tail_bytes.description: Number of bytes to parse from bottom of each file

encoding.description: Try decode source files from the specified codec; unset for no decoding

copyright.description: Add copyright statements to license information

skipped.description: Log files in PATHs matching neither --check nor --ignore as warnings

machine.description: Print license information as TAB-separated fields

quiet.description: Emit only error messages to STDERR
